summary: Repository development and quality tooling. Native Node 24 TypeScript tools use an explicit ESM package scope; shell and Python boundaries remain unchanged.

key_files.project-renderer-freshness.ts: Build-only content fingerprints for the Host project renderer. Vite records consumed modules, authored workspace sources and output outside the shipped client directory; Host packaging refuses stale or missing receipts.
key_files.runtime-dependency-identity.ts: Shared npm/Desktop packaging helper. Hashes materialized dependency contents once, excluding npm command links and installer bookkeeping; writes the adjacent identity consumed by Host upgrade detection.
key_files.ensure-dev-vars.ts: Creates or completes a Worker's git-ignored .dev.vars with ENVIRONMENT=development for vite dev and standalone api-cf dev. Committed wrangler configs describe deployed Workers and never carry that marker.
key_files.deploy-config-environment.test.ts: CI and predeploy gate: no tracked wrangler config may set ENVIRONMENT=development, which would let a deployed Worker use published fallback secrets.
key_files.source-check-config.ts: Materializes runtime-specific source-check paths from root tsconfig.source.json plus sparse source-check-profiles.json. Default/check mode only reports drift; --write explicitly refreshes generated profiles.
key_files.source-check-config.test.ts: Tests preservation of browser/app-local aliases and non-mutating failure when shared mappings change.
key_files.executable-scripts.test.ts: Executes native imports and the agent bundler in isolated fixtures, preserving generated JavaScript package boundaries without a release build.
key_files.packaged-runtime-binaries.ts: Shared npm/self-contained/Desktop packaging helper: npm invocation per platform, ffmpeg/ffprobe installer paths, and the executable bit a read-only install cannot repair later.
key_files.remotion-parity/: Server (@remotion/renderer) vs browser (@remotion/web-renderer) composition parity check. Generates ffmpeg fixtures at run time and gates every sample frame on SSIM >= 0.95; run with pnpm test:remotion-parity.
